name: Pork or Chicken Tamales (Smooth Masa, Mild Sauce)
whyItWorks: Tamale masa harina is ground into an ultra-fine flour and steamed with broth/fat until sponge-soft, avoiding un-ground corn kernel hulls.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose mild shredded pork or chicken/cheese fillings and skip spicy red chile sauces.
